en: This is a vintage postcard with a sepia-toned photograph on the front showing several wooden school buildings and a teacher's residence set in a rural landscape. The bottom of the image includes Swedish text identifying the location as Skönviks schools and teacher's residence. The back features handwritten Swedish text dated 1916, addressed to a recipient in Hagnäs, Hörneå, and printed with 'Brefkort' and 'Carte postale.'
